meta.name: Still 17
meta.description: Gong Woo-Jin is a 30-year-old single man and he works as a set designer. Due to a trauma he experienced 13 years ago, he does not want to have a relationship with others. When Woo Seo-Ri  was 17, she fell into a coma. 13 years later, she wakes up from her coma. Her mental age is still that of a 17-year-old, but she is now 30-years-old. Gong Woo-Jin and Woo Seo-Ri get involved with each other and fall in love.

videos.title: La Campanella
videos.overview: 17-year-old violinist Woo Seo Ri becomes comatose after a major bus crash. Gong Woo Jin, a 17-year-old boy who likes her, witnesses the whole thing. 13 years later, at age 30, Seo Ri wakes up.

videos.title: Where Are My Uncle and Aunt?
videos.overview: Seo Ri wakes up from her coma and realizes she is 30; Woo Jin's sister calls him back to Seoul.

videos.title: Elegant Ghost
videos.overview: Seo Ri learns that her aunt and uncle have moved.

videos.title: The Room Under the Stairs
videos.overview: Woo Jin, Chan, and Jennifer all hear something during the night. They go the first floor and are shocked to see something coming out of a cabinet. Seo Ri stays the night at Woo Jin's place and reveals how this house became as it is now.

videos.title: The Lands of the Unknown
videos.overview: Hyung Tae is eager to find Seo Ri and looks everywhere. Seo Ri finds out that the hospital is searching for her, yet decides not to return. Seo Ri realizes that Woo Jin used to go to school in Germany which made her curious about Woo Jin.

videos.title: Replacement
videos.overview: Seo Ri fails to make the cut for the orchestra, and Chan helps to comfort her feelings. While eating tteokbokki together, Seo Ri receives good news from the violin academy that she can perform for 2 to 3 weeks as a substitute.

videos.title: What If You Die Because of Me
videos.overview: Seo Ri sees a man who she thinks is her uncle while heading somewhere in a car. When she tries to runs to him while the car is still moving, Woo Jin encounters flashbacks of a bad memory and grabs Seo Ri to stop her from running.

videos.title: Apology
videos.overview: Once Seo Ri realizes that she may have confused some other man as her uncle, Seo Ri feels regretful for talking so cruelly toward Woo Jin and chooses to apologize to him.

videos.title: Moonlight
videos.overview: Woo Jin sees Seo Ri going into a bar while he is having a meeting with his clients. He follows Seo Ri and shouts her name loudly to find her, but soon gets dragged out by the bouncer.

videos.title: Flashbacks
videos.overview: While both Woo Jin and Chan have feelings for Seo Ri, each have very different approaches toward Seo Ri.

videos.title: I'm Scared
videos.overview: Seo Ri joins Hee Su's team to help her organize a music festival. However, Woo Jin feels uncomfortable with the situation and confronts Hee Su about the matter.

videos.title: Did I Do Something Wrong?
videos.overview: Seo Ri gets drunk during the team dinner, and accidently enters Woo Jin's room which brings a very awkward situation the next morning. Woo Jin tries to avoid Seo Ri to hide his feelings, but it get harder and harder.

videos.title: Bar 7
videos.overview: Woo Jin sees his doctor and confesses that Seo Ri made him change to be a different person from what he used to be. Meanwhile, Chan decides to express his feelings towards Seo Ri after winning at the national competition.

videos.title: I Want My Time Back
videos.overview: Woo Jin gets drunk while he was trying to protect Seo Ri from Mr. Kang at the bar. Afterwards, Woo jin's behavior makes Seo Ri question the reason behind it.

videos.title: Feeding the Fish
videos.overview: Seo Ri is looking for a place to stay and Hyun’s cousin’s place becomes her favorite option as everything is free to use there. Chan is crushed to hear that she will move out since he has plans to admit his feelings for her.

videos.title: Intermission
videos.overview: Woo Jin takes Seo Ri to the ocean to cheer her up; Seo Ri shares her perspective with Woo Jin, who feels sorry for how he treated her.
